sections.title: Viszlát and jó éjszakát
sections.content: *Viszlát* is the everyday goodbye — casual, and works at any time of day, unlike the "jó ..." greetings. *Jó éjszakát* is different from the others: it's not a greeting at all, only a parting phrase, used specifically when someone is going to bed.

Mixing these up is a classic beginner slip: saying *jó éjszakát* to someone at 3pm sounds like you're sending them to bed. Save it for when you or they are actually about to sleep — *viszlát* covers every other goodbye.
